# Felionoid
Felionoids are a small feline species known for being light on their feet.
## Age and names Felionoids have a lifespan similar to that of humans, albeit with more complications as they age. Their names are compound words. Each name is prefixed by their colony's or family's name, for example [color=yellow]silk[/color][color=orange]fur[/color]. Separating the parts of a compound name, even in casual conversation, is considered improper and may be rude. Many Felionoids replace their compound name with a nickname, or are given names more typical with human culture.
## Racial Features Their unarmed claw attacks deal [color=red]3[/color] points of Slash damage with a hit rate that is [color=yellow]2[/color] times faster than humans. As a result, they have an easier time [color=yellow]shoving[/color] and [color=red]disarming[/color] others.
Compared with humans, rested Felionoids run [color=lightgreen]25%[/color] faster.
Felionoids are also more vulnerable to damage: - They fall into a critical state at [color=red]85[/color] points of damage. - They die at [color=red]170[/color] points of damage.
## Light Sleep In light sleep, they can hear their surroundings and sense nearby entities through sound within [color=yellow]10 meters[/color].
## Nap Time After around [color=yellow]25 minutes[/color] without a nap, tiredness reduces their walking and running speeds by [color=yellow]5%[/color]. After [color=red]30 minutes[/color], the reduction reaches [color=red]25%[/color].
## Purring If Felionoids are injured while asleep, they automatically start purring to slowly recover from heat, cold, blunt, slash, piercing, and blood-loss damage, and heal bleeding. When held by an injured humanoid, Felionoids automatically purr to help with the healing process.
## Pounce Felionoids can leap into the arms of unsuspecting humanoids, whom they see as walking sleeping spots. The [color=yellow]Pounce[/color] action takes [color=yellow]2 seconds[/color] of tail-wiggling to charge; moving interrupts the charge. An empty-handed target can catch and pick up the pouncing Felionoid; otherwise, the impact knocks both down. Pounce recharges after [color=yellow]30 seconds[/color].
## Weapon Knockback Felionoids will find that large caliber weapons will push them around. They receive [color=yellow]Stun Damage[/color] for every shot fired from a large caliber weapon.
In general, the weapons that will give you knockback are [color=yellow]Rifles, Sniper Rifles, Shotguns, LMGs, HMGs, and Grenade Launchers.[/color]
Look out especially on Rocket launchers, as since they are recoilless, you will actually get [color=red]pulled forward with the rocket[/color] for a short distance. - The safest weapons to use that will give you no knockback are [color=green]Pistols and SMGs[/color]. - No slips can help mitigate some of the knockback from firing weapons, but not all of it! - Also keep in mind that any stamina resistance you have DOES work to reduce the stamina damage from these weapons.
